passes.rationale: Most directly linked to the existing native GFM sample already processed for this Tutorial; a useful first processing candidate, not a scientific ranking or complete event record.

limitations: The satellite analysis domain in 02_domain_selection.json is a candidate, not an approved observation boundary.
Source-product footprint intersections do not establish valid GFM flood-classification pixels; the existing processed sample has incomplete, patchy valid support.
The 14 and 16 July passes remain available in 03a_satellite_pass_inventory.csv for before/after comparison and are not selected in this initial proposal.
The evening 15 July S1B pass has no source-product GeoFootprints intersecting the current candidate AOI, despite GFM tile overlap.
